places.name: Café Fenchel Amadeus
places.description: Café Fenchel Amadeus is a place in Leipzig that serves specialty coffee. It serves coffee from Franz Morish. The menu includes espresso drinks and decaf, with plant-based milk available. Cakes are baked in house. It is open on Sundays.
